title: Qodo raises $70M for code verification as AI coding scales | TechCrunch
summary: Qodo, a startup focusing on AI code review, testing, and governance, has secured a $70 million Series B funding round amidst the growing need for reliable AI-generated code verification. Their approach considers organizational standards and risk tolerance, aiming to bridge the trust gap in code quality management.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a positive outlook on Qodo's innovative solution to a critical issue in AI code generation, highlighting significant funding and the company's strategic approach to improving trust in AI-generated code.
